description: One-shot, professional-grade software tasks. Each task is realistic, hard, and adversarially gated. The suite measures whether Spark Agent one-shots tasks more often than the strongest single-agent runs of Claude or Codex.

scoring.notes: Hidden gates are a separate floor: a run with any failing hidden gate is recorded as a non-pass even if the rubric score is high.
